reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and "Every batch lab-tested" on the box, plus the pocket sachets that would fit in my tote. A dollar a day with free shipping is okay for one trial box, but I would only buy one and see if my sleep or cramps change before ordering again.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference in sleep or cramps? I have wasted money on magnesium before, and a nice box and a QR code do not prove it works for me.
would_change_my_mind: A coupon or flash sale price under $25, or a money-back guarantee if I do not notice anything after a month.
